narr: A mesoscale convective system affected eastern Ohio during the morning of July 29th. Much of the convection was elevated, and only isolated wind damage reports were received. However, slow-moving storms in multiple bands did produce as much as 3 to 4.5 inches of rain, which also created some flooding concerns in Tuscarawas County.
